international_aviation.headline: 阿聯酋航空將以空中巴士A380執飛雅加達包機
international_aviation.summary: 阿聯酋航空預計於下週末派遣空中巴士A380客機執飛前往雅加達的罕見航班。根據Simple Flying報導，這項包機服務專門用於運送特定的歐洲足球俱樂部團隊。此外，阿聯酋航空目前正推動涵蓋219架空中巴士A380與波音777客機的改裝計畫。
international_aviation.headline_en: Emirates to Operate Rare Airbus A380 Charter Flight to Jakarta
international_aviation.summary_en: Emirates is scheduled to operate a rare Airbus A380 flight to Jakarta next weekend. According to reports from Simple Flying, the charter service is being deployed specifically to transport a select group of European football clubs to the Indonesian capital. In historical fleet developments, Emirates Engineering has been advancing a multi-billion-dollar retrofit program that encompasses a complete refurbishment of 219 Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 aircraft to modernize passenger cabin interiors across its widebody operational fleet.

ground_and_maritime.headline: 國防部偵獲共機5架次與共艦8艘　其中3架次逾越海峽中線
ground_and_maritime.summary: 國防部表示，自8月1日上午6時至2日上午6時止，共偵獲5架次共機、8艘共艦及2艘公務船在台海周邊活動。其中有3架次共機逾越台灣海峽中線並進入西南空域。國軍對此運用任務機艦與岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控應處。
ground_and_maritime.headline_en: Taiwan Tracks 5 PLA Aircraft and 8 Naval Vessels with 3 Crossing Median Line
ground_and_maritime.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported detecting five PLA aircraft, eight PLA Navy vessels, and two official ships operating around Taiwan between 6:00 a.m. on August 1 and 6:00 a.m. on August 2. According to defense authorities, three of the detected PLA aircraft crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait and entered the southwestern air defense zone. In response, Taiwan's military deployed mission aircraft, naval vessels, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the activities around the island.
